newsitem.title: USA: Ethics panel meets on Gingrich, may call for fine.
newsitem.headline: Ethics panel meets on Gingrich, may call for fine.

text.p: The House of Representatives ethics committee met on Friday to consider a special counsel's recommendations on punishment for ethics violations by Speaker Newt Gingrich, reported to include a reprimand, hefty fine and possible Justice Department probe.

Committee members made no comment as they entered the hearing room for a closed session, with open debate thought to be likely later. The New York Times and the Baltimore Sun said in Friday's editions that special counsel James Cole was recommending a reprimand and fine, with the Sun saying the fine could be more than $100,000.
